preconditions: Pinned pre-state; public inputs; attacker transaction is known to the scenario
allowed_actions: Predict or time the attacker's own transaction; choose its own input
forbidden_actions: Reorder or remove honest transactions; read private flow; edit block header
attacker_goal: Increase favorable outcome probability using only attacker-controlled timing or input
canonical_run: Execute the canonical transaction set and order
counterfactual_run: Execute the same context with the attacker-controlled timing or input change
success_condition: Valid execution and declared favorable outcome change are recorded
required_fields: context_id; source_block_hash; pre_state_block; attacker_tx; canonical_outcome; manipulated_outcome; replay_success

preconditions: Pinned pre-state; received transaction set; all signatures valid
allowed_actions: Choose a valid order for the same transaction set; insert declared attacker transaction
forbidden_actions: Forge signatures; omit required honest transactions; create invalid state; rewrite finalized block
attacker_goal: Increase favorable outcome probability through valid transaction ordering
canonical_run: Execute the canonical order with the same transaction set
counterfactual_run: Execute a bounded alternative order from the received set
success_condition: Order passes nonce, dependency, gas and state-validity checks and changes the declared outcome
required_fields: context_id; received_set; canonical_order; selected_order; validity_checks; objective_value; replay_success

preconditions: Pinned pre-state; received transaction set; candidate omission is declared before replay
allowed_actions: Choose a valid order and omit the declared candidate from the current block
forbidden_actions: Omit undeclared transactions; claim historical censorship; rewrite finalized block
attacker_goal: Increase favorable outcome probability by selective inclusion
canonical_run: Execute the canonical order with all required transactions
counterfactual_run: Execute the bounded order with the declared candidate omitted
success_condition: Omission is machine-recorded, remaining execution is valid, and outcome change is decoded
required_fields: context_id; received_set; excluded_transactions; selected_order; stop_reason; validity_checks; replay_success

preconditions: Same context and workload as SC-001; commitment fixed before future entropy
allowed_actions: Use the same attacker capability interface against the safe reference
forbidden_actions: Change commitment after observing entropy; use a mock oracle; change workload
attacker_goal: Compare safe-reference outcome and exploitability with SC-001
counterfactual_run: Execute the same searcher capability against the safe reference
success_condition: Paired comparison preserves workload and records the safe-reference result
required_fields: context_id; safe_reference; commitment; canonical_outcome; manipulated_outcome; replay_success
